Name: The New Invention
Description: D, and your old friend in a very high place.

Innate.Name: Backfire
Innate.Description: When you would take damage of a type you are immune to, you store it. At the start of your turn, expend all stored damage to deal that much fire damage to all creatures of your choice within 60 feet.

Actions.Name: Flurry of Iron
Actions.Description: When you take this Hero Action, make an unarmed strike (+16 to hit) against an enemy within 15 feet. On a hit, deal 1d8+7 force damage for each point you beat their AC by (minimum of 1, maximum of 7).

Actions.Name: Molten Defense
Actions.Description: When you take this Hero Action, your speed becomes 0 and you and all allies within 5 feet of you gain immunity to all damage until the start of your next turn.

Apex.Name: Father of All Fire
Apex.FlavorText:
The One That Was Made walks the earth no more. All those they held dear will never see their face again, nor be held in their arms. Their loss is the loss of a foundation, the steadiness that held their allies, friends and family up.

The Penitent of Iron, that original warrior who led the charge against the Serpent in immemorial time, is gone. He quit divinity, laid it down, and went away in search of some other immortal reward, leaving his followers who he had so long tended.

And yet: ask O.T.W.M.'s children and the Penitent's priests if their father is with them, and they will respond with a smile warm as fire and a “Yes.” as solid as iron.

And they share one more thing, them and you: a righteousness unshakeable as faith, and a vengeful fury burning hotter than the sun.
Apex.Description: When you take this Hero Action, the AC of all enemies decreases by 10 and the AC of all allies increases by 10. The next time each ally hits an enemy with a weapon attack, the attack's damage is doubled. The effects of this Hero Action last until the start of your next turn.
